# now.gg

> > Instant browser-based cloud gaming platform enabling free play of hundreds of games on PC and mobile without downloads or installation.

now.gg is a mobile cloud gaming platform that streams games directly to browsers, eliminating the need for downloads or device-specific installations. The platform specializes in casual, simulation, and anime games with a focus on accessibility across PC and mobile devices.
